mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent tightening cycle that increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and high inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy change > 2.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL yoy change > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when the trigger condition is met over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 1 month) signals robust corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 1 month and UNRATE < 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1400 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5 in the current month) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 102.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales growth (RSAFS growth > 0.8% in 1 month) signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.8% in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.
